tv_attention_fade_on_production.classification_evidence: Week-blocked bootstrap 95% interval [-4.39,+8.64] accuracy points crosses zero (below-power, not refuted); split-half (odd/even season) reliability of the underlying trailing-attention trait is r=0.648 (Spearman-Brown 0.786, n=31 teams, 95% CI [0.38,0.82]), so no_split_half_reliability is inadmissible; no positive control was run so positive_control_bound is inadmissible; per AGENTS.md this is unresolved_below_power, not closed.
tv_attention_fade_on_production.description: MKT-14: lagged Sports Media Watch trailing team attention (mean of last N=3 nationally-timestamped audience appearances, z-scored within primetime/Sunday-late/Sunday-early broadcast slot) stacked as a public-tax fade rule on production's weak_stack opener pick: flip to the other side when the picked team's own trailing attention sits in the top tercile of the pooled decile distribution.
tv_attention_fade_on_production.notes: Pooled 2020-2021 (matches other lanes' shared opener window tonight): n=456 non-push graded games, 141 picks changed, base 53.29% -> flipped 55.26% (+1.97 pts), P+ 0.717. Per-season: 2020 n=220 +4.55 pts P+ 0.813 [-5.26,+14.82]; 2021 n=236 -0.42 pts P+ 0.459 [-8.79,+7.93]. Decile-table cover rate (932 team-game observations, both sides pooled) is flat across deciles (Spearman rho=0.018 vs decile), no monotone public-tax gradient detected at this resolution. SMW ingestion coverage by season (usable, both-team, point-in-time-safe rows): 2014=11, 2015=82, 2016=76, 2017=3, 2018=28, 2019=69, 2020=67, 2021=81 (417 total); opener-graded per_game population only exists 2020-2025, so 2020-2021 is the sole feasible ATS-graded window. Decision: P+ above 0.5 favours playing the fade per AGENTS.md's promotion-bar-is-not-a-decision-bar rule, but this is a single below-power confirmation look, not a promotion; docs/tv_attention_screen.md has the full write-up.
tv_attention_fade_on_production.plain_summary: When the team we are about to pick has been drawing unusually large TV audiences lately, betting against that popular team instead is a coin flip in our data so far (slightly favours the fade, not enough games yet to be sure).
